serviceName: Siguree mail authentication (Google Workspace) with DMARC
description: Adds the DKIM key Siguree signs with and merges Google Workspace into SPF, so mail signed by Siguree passes DKIM and SPF. Also publishes a monitoring-only DMARC policy (p=none); Siguree uses this variant only when the domain has no DMARC record yet.
variableDescription: dkimkey: DKIM public key (base64) issued by Siguree for this domain
